title: Hearing French opera as a boy in Frenchtown
summary: Opera was his first music; his parents took him to the opera and his teacher got him into rehearsals.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What was the very first music you ever remember hearing? Can you remember?
Mostly opera because my father and mother were both opera fans. And we had the New Orleans French opera, which was not very far from where I was born.
Where were you born, by the way? In New Orleans. I mean, what part of the city, downtown?
In Frenchtown. About what street? And on Burgundy Street.

Oh, at least a couple of times a week, they would always take me to the opera. And of course, having been a student of the conductor, I became all the more interested in the opera because of him and through him. And he made it possible for me to even attend many of the opera rehearsals where I could hear the thing in action. And the more I heard it, the more I fell in love with it. And I think that has much to do with my knowledge of classical music now.
